metadata.title: Contact Costa Spanish Academy | Learn Spanish Online
metadata.description: Get in touch with Costa Spanish Academy. Ask about courses, schedules, trial lessons or business training. Personalised attention in English or Spanish.

supporting: Tell us what you would like to achieve with your Spanish. We will listen, answer your questions and help you find the right next step.

info.title: A real answer, from a real person.
info.intro: Whether you are choosing your first course or planning training for a team, our academy will guide you personally.
info.response: We normally reply within 24 business hours. Your details are used only to respond to your request and are never shared.

form.title: How can we help?
form.supporting: Share a few details and we will come back to you with clear, useful information.
form.messagePlaceholder: Tell us about your goals, availability or any questions you have.
form.submitNote: By sending this form, you agree that we may use your details to reply to your enquiry.
